Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring fuel tax revenue attributable to certain counties to be spent within those counties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motor vehicle fuel tax revenues attributable tocertain counties to be spent within those counties; adding new sectionsto chapter 82.36 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 46.68 RCW; andproviding an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of revenue shall determine the number of gallonsof motor vehicle fuel and special fuel sold within each county that hasa population greater than five hundred thousand. (2) Businesses engaged in the retail sale of motor vehicle fuel, orspecial fuel as defined in RCW 82.38.020, located within countiessubject to subsection (1) of this section, shall report the number ofgallons sold each month to the department of revenue.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each quarter of the calendar year, the department of revenue shall p. 1 HB 1404report the number of gallons of motor vehicle fuel and special fuelsold within the counties meeting the requirements of section 1(1) ofthis act to the department of transportation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.68 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of transportation shall expend motor vehicle fundrevenues attributed to counties under sections 1 and 2 of this actwithin the boundaries of those counties.
